Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The players stride out to the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are the openers for Ireland. Bilal Khan to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Ireland need 138 and they would be confident of chasing this down as they have the firepower in their batting. Oman need to take early wickets to put some pressure on them. Do join us shortly for the run chase.

A good bowling performance from Ireland! Mark Adair drew the first blood getting a wicket in the first over and then Craig Young removed Jatinder Singh as well but the bowlers could not capitalize on that. They leaked too many boundaries and that shifted the momentum towards Oman. They toiled hard but Curtis Campher got the breakthrough by removing Ayaan Khan. That brought the Irish players back in the game. The bowlers then chipped in with timely wickets and they would be happy with their efforts. The star for them was definitely Simi Singh who picked up 3 wickets for just 9 runs in his four-overs quota.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another excellent catch! Ireland have been superb in the field today! A length ball, around middle. Bilal Khan heaves this towards deep mid-wicket, but he gets a top edge to it. Andy Balbirnie runs to his left and takes a good low catch to dismiss the last man, Bilal Khan! Oman end at 137/10!
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Oman started off aggressively as Shoaib Khan dealt only in boundaries and was looking in super touch. Jatinder Singh and Kashyap Prajapati fell inside the Powerplay but Shoaib Khan kept the innings going. There was a partnership blossoming between Ayaan Khan and Shoaib Khan, but the former got out. After that, the acceleration never came as wickets kept tumbling down and the side ended up putting a below-par total on the board.

Oman had a good start to their innings but no one could attack at the death as wickets fell like a pack of cards for them. 135 against Nepal and here, they are restriced to almost the same score. Ireland would be pleased with their bowling performance and would fancy their chances here. Oman lost their last six wickets for just 50 runs and they would be disappointed with that.
WIDE! A fuller ball, wide of off. Bilal Khan looks to slash this but misses. Wide called.
Bilal Khan is the last batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! Mark Adair strikes now, the last thing Oman wanted. Naseem could have guided them to a good total in this last over, but he perishes. A low full toss, around off. Naseem smashes this towards long off, but the ball goes off the bottom of the bat. Harry Tector (sub) at long off takes an easy catch to dismiss Naseem!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Harry Tector b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! A length ball, around off. Kaleemullah clears his front foot and heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Pacey ball, on a length, outside off. Kaleemullah swings his bat at it but misses.
Fuller, outside off, slower ball. Naseem Khushi lifts it over mid off for a single.
Slower ball, around middle, fuller. Kaleemullah knocks it o long on for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle. Naseem Khushi pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Oman need more of these! Very full, wide of off. Naseem Khushi slashes this over cover for a boundary.
Another slower delivery, on the pads. Naseem Khushi clips it to square leg for a single.
Another length ball, around middle. Kaleemullah flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tad fuller, around middle. Naseem Khushi taps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Kaleemullah walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Fayyaz Butt goes back now! Oman slip further! A length ball, outside off. Fayyaz Butt drives it to Andy Balbirnie at cover. He did not want single there, but Naseem Khushi wanted the strike and he left his crease to get to the other end. Andy Balbirnie was quick to collect the ball and throw it back to the bowler, who collects the ball and whips the bails off.
Length ball, outside off. Fayyaz Butt looks to cut it away but gets an under-edge back to the keeper.
Back of a length, around middle. Naseem Khushi looks to pull, but he gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Fayyaz Butt drives it back to the bowler. Craig Young does well to stop the ball on his followthrough.
Fuller, outside off. Fayyaz Butt has a slash at it but fails to connect.
On a length, around middle. Naseem Khushi taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Something to smile about for Oman! A fuller ball, outside off. Naseem Khushi tonks it over long on for a biggie.

Mix-up... but safe! A length ball, outside off. Fayyaz Butt taps it towards point. A bit of a late call, and Fayyaz Butt was just halfway down the pitch. Paul Stirling takes a shy at non-striker's end but misses. One run completed.
Fuller ball, outside off. Naseem Khushi taps it to mid off for a single.
Fayyaz Butt is the new batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another bites the bust! Wickets keep tumbling for Oman! Simi Singh gets another wicket. A leg break, fuller, on middle. Khurram Nawaz gets low and goes for the sweep but he does so with the inner half of his bat. The ball flies high and goes to George Dockrell at deep square leg who takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: A leg break this time, around the leg stump. Khurram Nawaz taps it to fine leg for a single.
Quicker, flatter, woks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leg bye! A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Khurram Nawaz looks to sweep but misses. The ball deflects off his pads and goes towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Quicker, outside off. Khurram Nawaz taps it towards point and takes a quick single.
Shorter ball, outside off. stays back and looks to cut it away but misses.
Back of a length, on middle. Khurram Nawaz pulls it to deep square leg and retains the strike.
Slower bouncer, on middle. Pulled to fine leg for a run.
FOUR! Length ball, on middle. Naseem Khushi flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a welcome boundary.
Good-length ball, on middle. Khurram Nawaz prods and pushes it past the bowler for a quick single.
On a length, on the pads. Naseem Khushi clips it to square leg for one.
Naseem Khushi walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Shoaib Khan perishes as well. Fuller in length, on off. Shoaib Khan chips it straight down the throat of the long off fielder. Simi Singh is stationed in the deep and he takes the simplest of catches there. Oman losing wickets in quick succession here. A fine knock from Shoaib Khan comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Craig Young (2-0-5-1) is back into the attack.
A googly, on off. Khurram Nawaz drives it to silly mid on.
Khurram Nawaz is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Simi Singh drags his length back and bowls it short, on leg. Khawar Ali shimmies down and looks to pull but miscues it completely. The ball lobs up near him and Lorcan Tucker takes a couple of steps forward and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: On off, pushed towards covers for a single.
This is tucked on the leg side for a single.
Tosses it up, on off. Khawar Ali reverse-sweeps it but straight to short third man.
Loopy ball, on leg. Swept to short fine leg for a quick single.
Short of a length, on middle. Khawar Ali smacks it to wide of deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and does well to cut it off. Saves two runs for his team.
Back of a length, on middle. Khawar Ali advances and looks to slap it over mid-wicket. The ball goes off the outside edge to deep point for a brace.
Short of a length, on middle. Shoaib Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
On a length, on off. Khawar Ali taps it to point for a run.
Good-length ball, outside off.  Khawar Ali looks to cut but misses.
Short ball, on middle. Shoaib Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket only for a single.
Carrom ball, on off. Shoaib Khan eases it down to long off and retains the strike.
Loopy ball, on middle. Pushed past the bowler to long on for one.
Floats it up, on middle. Flicked straight to mid-wicket.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on leg, drilled down to long on for a single.
Khawar Ali comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper of Oman departs! Tossed up, on middle and leg. Zeeshan Maqsood sits on one knee and slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. Does not have enough power on that one and Gareth Delany settles under it and pouches it easily. Oman lose their fourth wicket now!
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Short again, on middle. Zeeshan Maqsood pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Well executed! Short of a length, on off. Zeeshan Maqsood plays it late and guides it to third man for a boundary. Deft touch on that one!
WIDE! Length ball, down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Full and on off, driven to long off for a single.
On the pads, worked to fine leg for a single.
FIFTY! Length ball, on off. Shoaib Khan dabs it to short third man for a single. He gets to his fifty and has played a wonderful knock for his team.
Length ball, outside off. Maqsood cuts it hard to deep cover for a single.
Fuller, on middle. Shoaib Khan pushes it back to the bowler.
Leg bye! Firing it down the leg side, shorter ball. Zeeshan Maqsood looks to flick but the ball brushes off his pads and goes towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye!
Around off, quicker this time, fuller. Shoaib Khan works it away towards mid-on for a single.
Leg bye! Fuller, around leg. Zeeshan Maqsood goes for the sweep but misses. The ball deflects off the pads and goes towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Flatter, around middle and leg. Zeeshan Maqsood steps down taps it to mid-wicket for a quick .
Fuller, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off. Shoaib Khan leans and blocks it out.
Zeeshan Maqsood is the new batsman in.

OUT! TAKEN! Curtis Campher strikes and sends back Ayaan Khan who was looking quite promising! Curtis Campher drops it short, around middle. Ayaan Khan goes for the pull, but gets a thick top edge towards fine leg. Craig Young keeps his eyes on the ball and takes an excellent catch. Ayaan Khan departs! Oman lose their third wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Young b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: 1 run, played towards fine leg. Good-length delivery, around the pads. Shoaib Khan clips it towards fine leg. A single taken.
Length ball, around middle. Ayaan Khan taps it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Shoaib Khan pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Spraying it down the leg side, on a length. Shoaib Khan looks to flick but misses. Wide given!
Shoter ball, around middle. Ayaan Khan was looking to block this but gets a slight edge towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Fuller ball, tosses this one up. Ayaan Khan taps it towards mid-wicket for a single. Big over for Oman! 14 off it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Flatter ball, down the leg side. Ayaan Khan nudges it towards fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! A full toss ball, on middle. Ayaan Khan shimmies down the pitch and slams it over deep mid-wicket for a six.
Fuller again, outside off. Shoaib Khan pushes it towards point for a single.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Ayaan Khan pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter, outside off. Shoaib Khan stays back and cuts it past point for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Ayaan Khan blocks it towards mid on. Dot to end the over.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A fuller ball, outside off. Ayaan Khan leans and drives it past cover for a boundary.
Length, outside off. Ayaan Khan taps it to point.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Shoaib Khan leans and taps it to point for a quick single.
FOUR! Top shot! On a length, wide of off. Shoaib Khan stays back and slashes this past point for a boundary.
Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Ayaan Khan looks to drive. The ball goes off the inside half to deep square leg for a single. End of the Powerplay, Oman are 44/2.
Short ball, on off. Ayaan Khan looks to pull but misses.
Full and on off, pushed to mid on for a run.
Short ball, on middle. Ayaan Khan pulls it to square leg for a single.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
Length ball, on middle. Played to mid on for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Ayaan Khan keeps it out.
On the pads, tucked to short fine leg for a run.
Outside off, pushed towards covers for a run.
This is clipped to square leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Shoaib Khan keeps it out.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length ball, outside off. Shoaib Khan plays it late and through point for a boundary.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling (C), Andy Balbirnie (WK), Gareth Delany, Curtis Campher, Shane Getkate, Lorcan Tucker, George Dockrell, Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Josh Little.

Oman (Playing XI) - Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Naseem Khushi (WK), Jatinder Singh, Khawar Ali, Fayyaz Butt (In for Mohammad Nadeem), Ayaan Khan, Kashyap Prajapati, Kaleemullah, Bilal Khan, Khurram Nawaz, Shoaib Khan.
Good-length ball, on off. Ayaan Khan defends it out.
Short ball, on middle. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs a short ball, on middle. Ducked under.
Ayaan Khan comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! A wicket against the run of play! Craig Young strikes in his first over. Short of a length, on middle. Jatinder Singh tries to find a boundary as well. He pulls it to deep mid-wicket but does not have legs on that one and Shane Getkate in the deep takes the catch. Oman lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Shane Getkate b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Jatinder Singh taps it to point.
Craig Young comes into the attack.
On a good length, outside off. Jatinder Singh pushes it towards covers.
Fuller in length, on off. Jatinder Singh pushes it wide of mid on for a run.
Slower ball, on middle. Shoaib Khan nudges it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful! Shoaib Khan is dealing in boundaries! Outside off, on a length. Shoaib Khan drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Confident-looking shot! Length ball, outside off. Shoaib Khan smashes it over mid off for yet another boundary.
On a length, on off. Jatinder Singh blocks it onto the deck and sets off for a quick single.
Length ball, on middle. Played to mid on.
FOUR! What a start this is for Shoaib Khan! That's his fifth boundary. Short of a length, on middle. Shoaib Khan smacks it past mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! What a shot! On a length, outside off. Shoaib Khan drives it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Shoaib Khan defends it towards covers.
FOUR! Shot! Touch fuller, on off. Shoaib Khan drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Shoaib Khan keeps it out.
Good-length ball, outside off. Shoaib Khan has a wild slash at it but misses.
Josh Little will bowl from the other end.
On middle, tucked to square leg for a single. An eventful first over comes to an end. A wicket and 9 runs off it.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Shoaib Khan looks to drive. The ball goes off the inside edge to fine leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery! On the pads, on a length. Shoaib Khan tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
Shoaib Khan is the new man in.

OUT! OUT! TIMBER! Adair strikes straightaway. Bowls a pin-point yorker, on middle. Prajapati could do nothing there. He tries to dig it out but the ball was too quick for him. It sneaks through his bat and rattles the stumps behind him. Ireland with an early breakthrough!
Good-length ball, outside off. Prajapati cuts it to point.
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out
We are ready to begin! The players are out in the middle. Kashyap Prajapati and Jatinder Singh will open the batting for Oman. Mark Adair will begin with the ball. Here we go...
TOSS - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

Oman, on the other hand, have a quality side but they failed to get over the line in the first game. The top-order of Oman failed to chip in with runs and they will want to step up in this important clash. Their bowlers did a good job, but they had too little to defend. However, they will want to continue to be disciplined with their bowling. Will the Irish win their first game? OR will Oman come back after their defeat? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

Ireland have a well-balanced side, although they have not been at their best in the shortest format, they will be coming into this game with some kind of confidence after defeating West Indies in the ODI series. They have a strong batting lineup, Paul Stirling was looking in good form in the Pakistan Super League, and he will be hoping he carries on the same way. With their bowling attack also looking fierce, the Irish will be looking to come out on top today.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th match of the Oman Quadrangular T20I series which sees Ireland taking on Oman. After the first match of Ireland being postponed against UAE, they play their first game here. Whereas, Oman are coming into this game after suffering a loss against Nepal. It will be interesting to see which team comes out on top in this exciting series.
... MATCH DAY ...
